==Biography==
Laurynas is from Kaunas, Lithuania. Before playing League of Legends he was a professional Starcraft 2 player, for teams like [[aAa]], mTL and Virus. He has never played with anyone within a ranked team outside of the 4 other members of GamingGear.eu.

In June 2017, Nbs joined '''Glitch''', a competitive ''PUBG'' team and started his new career as a professional ''PUBG'' player. In September 2018, he joined '''Ninjas in Pyjamas'''' ''PUBG'' team.<ref>[https://nip.gl/pubg/nip-welcomes-a-brand-new-pubg-squad/ NiP Welcomes A Brand New PUBG Squad] ''nip.gl''</ref>

In January 2021, Nbs joined '''Raise Your Edge Gaming''', a competitive ''VALORANT'' team as their coach.<ref>[https://twitter.com/TeamRYE/status/1355561846561009667 Raise Your Edge Gaming's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref> The roster was later acquired by '''Acend''' in March 2021.<ref>[https://twitter.com/AcendClub/status/1369732394379407360 Acend's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref> '''Acend''' was one of the best European teams in the ''VALORANT'' 2021 season, winning domestic tournaments as well as the first ''VALORANT'' World Championship.

== Trivia ==
* Is taking a break from studying Law after 3 years of doing so, to pursue a pro gaming career.
* His nickname started out as Nobody.
